title: Consciousness+: a wider property of which consciousness is one aspect

statements.text: Conscious subjects have causal powers and spatial extension, which consciousness alone does not seem to supply. So there is a more expansive property, consciousness+, that holds consciousness as one aspect. Its non-phenomenal aspects may never be grasped, and Goff is cautiously pessimistic that they will.

sources.quote: there is a more expansive property, call it consciousness+, that subsumes consciousness as one aspect
